title: Sausage toast
instructions: is made by scalding the sausages in boiling water, frying to a light brown, chop fine, and spread on bits of toast. To make
take a quart buttermilk, three eggs, tea-spoon soda, half tea-spoon salt,  flour to thicken; bake on griddle.
